title: PUBG GLOBAL SERIES 9 GRAND FINALS DAY 1 IS LIVE!
author: JBowlerr
contents:
[p]Hello, PUBG Esports Fans!

PGS Circuit 3 is about to conclude with an explosive four days of PUBG esports action at [b]PGS 9[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]As the Circuit Final approaches, here’s what you need to know about the tournament format, where to watch, drops and more.

[/p][h3][b]Schedule[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Survival Stage[/b]: August 20th[/p][list][*][p]Seeding for PGS 9 is based on teams’ performance in PGS 7 and 8. The Top 8 teams from those tournaments will bypass the Survival Stage and go directly to the Finals. Everyone else will duke it out in the 16-team Survival Stage on Thursday, in a last-chance dash to make it to the ultimate PGS Finals lobby. Only the Top 8 can advance from the Survival Stage![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Grand Finals[/b]: August 21st - 23rd[/p][list][*][p]A  no-holds-barred three day BO15 fight for the PGS Champion title. It’s the classic SUPER format you know and love - the team with the most points at the end of the third match day will be crowned the Champion. But since PGS 9 is the Circuit 3 Final, there’s a twist - the top performers in the PGS 7 & 8 Winner’s stage receive Advantage Points which are added to their standings at the start of the respective Final Stage.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,,,,,,"][tr][td][p]Winners Stage Placement[/p][p][/p][/td][td][p]1st[/p][p][/p][/td][td][p]2nd[/p][p][/p][/td][td][p]3rd[/p][p][/p][/td][td][p]4th[/p][p][/p][/td][td][p]5th[/p][p][/p][/td][td][p]6th[/p][p][/p][/td][td][p]7th[/p][p][/p][/td][td][p]8th[/p][p][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Advantage Points [/p][/td][td][p]10 [/p][/td][td][p]6 [/p][/td][td][p]5 [/p][/td][td][p]4 [/p][/td][td][p]3 [/p][/td][td][p]2 [/p][/td][td][p]1 [/p][/td][td][p]1 [/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3][b]Drops & Where to Watch[/b][/h3][p]Tune in on Twitch and Kick to earn progress towards Drops!
